review.verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The central unknown-decay adaptation object is not characterized: the note proves only 1 \le A_T(C) \le O(T^{1/(4\beta_-+2)}), while divergence, subpolynomial adaptation, and sharp order all remain open. The claimed beta-aware exponent is only an achievability ceiling because the converse is the generic no-carryover T^{-1/2} obstruction, which does not match T^{-\beta/(2\beta+1)}. The exact constant 8e-4 applies to an auxiliary homogeneous-history variance, not estimator risk, maximal bias, or minimax risk, so it cannot supply the missing sharpness. The exact B-risk persistent branch and the conditional mismatch identity improve finite certificates but do not resolve either the oracle rate or the adaptation tradeoff. The framing accurately discloses these limitations and does not falsely claim that the open adaptation frontier or oracle order has been determined.

DIRECTED IMPROVEMENT (re-derive the SAME object implementing this, do not reproduce the prior note): Prove a carryover-sensitive minimax lower bound of order T^{-\beta/(2\beta+1)} for R_T(\beta;C), matching the Markov achievability exponent; then recompute the adaptation-index bracket using this oracle denominator rather than the universal no-carryover T^{-1/2} bound.
